## GTA 6's Next-Gen Wanted System Explained by Push Square

When it comes to the Grand Theft Auto series, interacting with law enforcement is a foundational pillar of the experience. However, a recent discussion from gaming media outlet Push Square highlights a refreshing perspective on one of the franchise's most iconic features: escaping the cops in the upcoming GTA 6.

### Rethinking the Classic Police Chase

For many players, the traditional mechanics of evading a wanted level in previous GTA games can sometimes feel a bit formulaic. As pointed out in the recent media coverage, once a pursuit is triggered, the gameplay loop often boils down to driving your vehicle as fast as humanly possible and desperately trying to steer clear of any police units that spontaneously spawn in your general vicinity. While it delivers immediate adrenaline, the repetition of this tactic has left some players looking for a more dynamic and engaging approach.

### What the Next-Gen System Brings

With Grand Theft Auto VI heading into the next-generation hardware generation, expectations for an overhauled wanted system are exceptionally high. The introduction of new icons and refined system details suggests that Rockstar Games is looking closely at how players interact with law enforcement. While complete details are still emerging, analysis indicates that a smarter, more context-aware police system could finally replace the old spawn-and-chase routine, offering a completely fresh layer of strategy to the open-world chaos.

### Editor's Take

Escaping the police is the defining heartbeat of any GTA game, but modernizing it is long overdue. If GTA 6 successfully transforms the old cat-and-mouse routine into a truly reactive next-generation experience, it will completely redefine open-world crime gameplay.
